title: Austin Grimm returns to the roots with poetic new single “Garden of Youth”
htmlContent: Austin Grimm is sure of himself as he moves on to a new stage with the release of "Garden of Youth," the title track from his first solo album, which will come out on December 12, 2025. The single gives us a look at the artist's most personal work to date, complete with deep reflection, complex stories, and a return to the small truths that make us who we are. Grimm is going back to parts of himself that were never lost, just waiting to be recognized. "Garden of Youth" is a meditation on identity, belonging, and the deep understanding that comes from thinking about where you came from. His words are full of calm memories, but they also show an undeniable drive to move forward. This is the sound of an artist who respects his roots while also welcoming change. https://open.spotify.com/track/0Hx3jG8akvKfHCtNtofA2F   The single perfectly blends the realness of folk music with the laid-back feel of an island, all with a touch of Americana warmth. "Garden of Youth" shows how self-discovery happens slowly and in a big way, and that home is a feeling, and that adulthood still holds some of the child's first impressions of the world. This release shows that growing up makes wonder stronger, not weaker. "Garden of Youth" is both an inviting offer and a peaceful return, marking the start of a solitary story that promises depth, warmth, and lasting emotion.
